definitions: 防腐剂；用于抑制微生物生长、延缓食物或液体变质的物质

examples.text: Adding a bucket of brandy to a water barrel kept water fresh longer because alcohol is a preservative that kills harmful microbes.
examples.explanation: 在这里，preservative 指“防腐剂”。酒精能够杀死有害微生物，因此可以延缓桶中水的变质。

source.text: A brief history of alcohol - Rod Phillips
